name: W Hollywood
insider_take: This Hollywood hotspot sits at the epicenter of Tinseltown glamour, where A-listers and industry insiders converge just steps from the legendary Walk of Fame.
whats_special: The W Hollywood occupies a prime spot on Hollywood Boulevard, directly across from the iconic TCL Chinese Theatre and Dolby Theatre (home of the Oscars). The hotel's rooftop pool and lounge offer stunning views of the Hollywood Hills and the famous Hollywood Sign, while the lobby frequently buzzes with entertainment industry meetings and celebrity sightings.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 10+ for unobstructed Hollywood Sign views, and time your rooftop visit during golden hour for Instagram-worthy shots with the sign as your backdrop.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature cocktail experience at the rooftop bar during sunset, and take advantage of being walking distance to the Hollywood & Highland entertainment complex. The concierge can often arrange last-minute tickets to TV show tapings at nearby studios like Jimmy Kimmel Live! or secure reservations at exclusive industry hangouts.
pros: Prime Hollywood location with easy access to entertainment venues and attractions
Trendy rooftop bar and pool area with stunning city views
Modern, stylish rooms with contemporary amenities and design
Vibrant nightlife scene and celebrity spotting opportunities
cons: Can be quite loud due to bustling Hollywood location and nightlife activity
Premium pricing typical of luxury Hollywood properties
